facts.anchor: You quit your job to sell sex toys? Shelby texted as I was opening the store the next morning.
facts.fact: Meg 说出与 Zak 的联结：I like him, but we're just friends. She's damn sure right.

facts.anchor: “Really, Roddie?” I muttered under my breath.
facts.fact: 母亲的侦查式提问「Did you wash your face?」与 Meg 的辩解（Georgia 恢复得好但累了）——她在餐桌上把「见过 Zak」说成实话。

facts.anchor: Yes, I texted Shelby. I’m busy doing that right now. Long day today. I’ll call tomorrow.
facts.fact: Zak 说哥哥不能跟 Zara 说（她会难受），所以买咖啡站着跟她倒苦水。

facts.anchor: Then I texted Roddie before I finished my opening routine.
facts.fact: Meg 指出「你已经送我一本 Penthouse 了」，并说有人来问过——她让对方去敲三下门找 Zak。

facts.anchor: It didn’t really bother me that he’d ratted me out. I was glad my kids were close enough to share secrets with each other. I had always wanted a sibling and always worried I’d waited too lon
facts.fact: 她送 Roddie 上学时听见同学叫他「Mr. Roddie」——青春期的新身份与旧名字并存。
